examples.title: A detached .p7s over a file, chain embedded, time pinned
An attached message from a PKCS#12, PAdES-style (no signingTime), written to the sandbox

description: Produce an RFC 5652 SignedData over `content` (attached, or `detached:true`) or over a precomputed `contentDigest` (detached only — the PDF /ByteRange case), with ONE signer: `signer` (a PKCS#8 key or a PKCS#12 file, imported as a NON-EXTRACTABLE Web Crypto key — nothing generates or exports a key here) and `certificate` (required with signer.key; a PKCS#12 bag's certificate serves otherwise), `chain` and `crls` parsed (never embedded unread) then embedded. Signed attributes are always written: contentType, messageDigest, signingTime (default PKINATIVE_MCP_AT or now, whole seconds; 'none' omits it — pin it for reproducible bytes), SigningCertificateV2 and CMSAlgorithmProtection (on by default; CAdES / PAdES need them), plus your `signedAttributes` / `unsignedAttributes` (DER Attributes as hex). `sid` defaults to issuerAndSerialNumber (keep it unless the reader is known). The new signature is verified against the signer certificate BEFORE it is returned (KEY_MISMATCH otherwise). RSA keys need signer.rsaScheme; SHA-1 needs allowSha1:true. Output DER (default; .p7s), PEM (label CMS) or hex, inline or as a sandbox file (never overwritten). Add a counter time-stamp afterwards with amend_cms.

allowSha1.description: Accept or produce SHA-1 signatures (legacy material you already trust). Default false: refused with PKI_CRYPTO_ALGORITHM_REFUSED on read, VALIDATION_ERROR on write.

certificate.description: The signer certificate: exactly one of pem / derBase64 / path. Required with signer.key; optional with signer.p12 (the bag's certificate is used, and this one wins when both are given).

derBase64.description: DER bytes as base64, exactly once (not PEM text).

path.description: Relative path of a PEM / DER file inside the PKINATIVE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR sandbox (never cached).

chain.description: Further certificates to embed (the chain) (every PEM block of every item is taken). The signer certificate is always embedded once; a PKCS#12 bag's other certificates are added too.

items.description: Further certificates to embed (the chain): exactly one of pem / derBase64 / path.

derBase64.description: DER bytes as base64, exactly once (not PEM text).

path.description: Relative path of a PEM / DER file inside the PKINATIVE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR sandbox (never cached).

content.description: The content to sign (hashed with the signer's digest; embedded unless detached): exactly one of text / base64 / path.

base64.description: The content to sign (hashed with the signer's digest; embedded unless detached) as base64 bytes (≤ 128 MiB decoded). Exclusive with text / path.

path.description: Relative path of a file inside the sandbox (any extension, ≤ 1 GiB). Exclusive with text / base64.

text.description: The content to sign (hashed with the signer's digest; embedded unless detached) as UTF-8 text. Exclusive with base64 / path.

contentDigest.description: The content's digest, already computed with the signer's digest algorithm (the PDF /ByteRange case). Requires detached:true. Exclusive with content. Hexadecimal (an 0x prefix, colons and spaces are tolerated).

contentType.description: The eContentType (dotted OID). Default id-data (1.2.840.113549.1.7.1); any other makes a version 3 SignedData.

crls.description: CRLs to embed (DER or X509 CRL PEM) (every PEM block of every item is taken).

items.description: CRLs to embed (DER or X509 CRL PEM): exactly one of pem / derBase64 / path.

derBase64.description: DER bytes as base64, exactly once (not PEM text).

path.description: Relative path of a PEM / DER file inside the PKINATIVE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR sandbox (never cached).

detached.description: Omit the content from the SignedData (the signature travels without what it signs; most S/MIME and every PDF signature).

encoding.description: Artefact encoding: 'pem' (RFC 7468 text), 'der' (raw bytes), 'hex' (lowercase hex in structuredContent, inline only, ≤ 64 KiB). Default 'der'.

encodingRules.description: 'der' (strict X.690 DER, default) or 'ber' (indefinite / non-minimal lengths and constructed strings, as legacy CMS producers write).

limits.description: Raise pkinative's 22 named security bounds for this call (trusted input only; absent keys keep the engine defaults). A value above an operator ceiling (PKINATIVE_MCP_MAX_INPUT_BYTES, PKINATIVE_MCP_MAX_KDF_ITERATIONS, PKINATIVE_MCP_MAX_PATHS_EXPLORED) is LIMIT_CEILING_EXCEEDED; describe_engine lists the defaults and the ceilings.

maxAttributes.description: The attributes of one attribute set. Default 256.

maxBerSegments.description: The segments joined from one BER constructed string. Default 10000.

maxChainLength.description: The certificates one certification path may hold. Default 10.

maxCmsCertificatesAndCrls.description: The certificates and revocation entries one SignedData carries. Default 1024.

maxDepth.description: The nesting depth of constructed values. Default 64.

maxExtensions.description: The extensions of one certificate or request. Default 256.

maxGeneralNames.description: The GeneralName entries of one field. Default 10000.

maxInputBytes.description: The size of one DER input, or the length of one PEM text. Default 67108864.

maxIntegerBytes.description: The content length of one INTEGER converted to a bigint. Default 8192.

maxKdfIterations.description: The PBKDF2 iteration count honoured in one derivation. Default 10000000.

maxNameAttributes.description: The attributes of one distinguished name. Default 1024.

maxNodes.description: The number of values decoded from one input. Default 200000.

maxOcspSingleResponses.description: The SingleResponse entries of one OCSP response. Default 256.

maxOidBytes.description: The content length of one OBJECT IDENTIFIER. Default 256.

maxPathsExplored.description: The candidate paths explored while building one (the RFC 5280 §6 work bound). Default 1000.

maxPemBlocks.description: The blocks read from one PEM text. Default 10000.

maxPkcs12Bags.description: The SafeBags read from one PKCS#12, across every SafeContents. Default 4096.

maxPkcs12KdfIterations.description: The PBKDF2 iterations one PKCS#12 costs in total. Default 10000000.

maxPolicies.description: The policies or policy mappings of one extension. Default 1024.

maxPolicyNodes.description: The live nodes of the RFC 5280 valid_policy_tree. Default 4096.

maxRevokedCertificates.description: The entries walked in one CRL revokedCertificates list. Default 1000000.

maxSignerInfos.description: The signers of one SignedData. Default 64.

outputMode.description: 'base64' (default) returns the artefact inline as an embedded resource (≤ 50 MiB). 'file' writes it inside PKINATIVE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR (never overwrites; ≤ 1 GiB) and returns a resource_link.

outputPath.description: Relative path inside the sandbox (only when outputMode='file'); the extension must match the encoding (.p7s .p7m .p7b .cms .der for der; .pem for pem). Key-bearing extensions (.key .p8 .p12 .pfx) are refused: nothing here writes a private key.

pemMode.description: 'strict' (RFC 7468 exactly, default) or 'lax' (tolerates whitespace, line length and RFC 1421 headers).

sid.description: How the SignerInfo names the certificate. Keep issuerAndSerialNumber unless the reader is known: subjectKeyIdentifier (version 3) is refused by some deployed readers and needs the certificate's SKI extension.

signedAttributes.description: Further signed attributes, each one DER Attribute as hex, written verbatim. A type the builder writes itself, a repeated type or a countersignature is refused (PKI_API_MISUSE).

items.description: One DER Attribute (SEQUENCE { type, SET OF values }). Hexadecimal (an 0x prefix, colons and spaces are tolerated).

signer.description: The signing key: exactly one of `key` (a PKCS#8 private key, plain or PBES2-encrypted, PEM or DER) or `p12` (a PKCS#12 file, PBES2 + PBMAC1 only). The key is imported into a NON-EXTRACTABLE Web Crypto key and never leaves the engine; no result ever carries a key byte. The algorithm follows the key: ECDSA on the key's curve, Ed25519/Ed448 (no hash), RSA REQUIRES rsaScheme ('pkcs1' | 'pss' — pkinative has no default). SHA-1 only with the tool's allowSha1:true.

hash.description: Signature hash. Default: the curve's hash for ECDSA (SHA-256/384/512), SHA-256 for RSA; refused for Ed25519 / Ed448 (which hash internally). 'SHA-1' needs allowSha1:true.

key.description: The PKCS#8 private key (PRIVATE KEY or ENCRYPTED PRIVATE KEY; SEC1 / PKCS#1 keys must be converted with openssl pkcs8 -topk8 first): exactly one of pem / derBase64 / path. Exclusive with p12.

derBase64.description: DER bytes as base64, exactly once (not PEM text).

path.description: Relative path of a PEM / DER file inside the PKINATIVE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR sandbox (never cached).

keyType.description: The type of an ENCRYPTED PKCS#8 key (it reveals its type only once decrypted); not needed when the tool has the matching certificate or public key.

p12.description: The PKCS#12 file (.p12 / .pfx; PBES2 and PBMAC1 only — a legacy RC2 / 3DES file is refused with the OpenSSL 3.4 conversion remedy): exactly one of pem / derBase64 / path. Exclusive with key.

derBase64.description: DER bytes as base64, exactly once (not PEM text).

path.description: Relative path of a PEM / DER file inside the PKINATIVE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR sandbox (never cached).

password.description: The password of an encrypted PKCS#8 key or a PKCS#12 file (UTF-8). Never echoed, logged or cached. Alternatively set PKINATIVE_MCP_PASSWORD in the server environment and omit this input (never both) — the variable keeps the secret out of the model transcript.

rsaScheme.description: REQUIRED for an RSA key: 'pkcs1' (RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5) or 'pss' (RSA-PSS). An id-RSASSA-PSS key signs with 'pss' only. Refused for non-RSA keys.

saltLength.description: RSA-PSS salt length in bytes (rsaScheme:'pss' only; default: the hash length).

signingCertificateV2.description: Write the ESS SigningCertificateV2 attribute (RFC 5035), binding the signature to this certificate — CAdES, PAdES and RFC 3161 require it.

signingTime.description: The claimed signing time: an ISO 8601 instant, epoch milliseconds, 'now', or 'none' to omit the attribute (PAdES forbids it, S/MIME expects it). Whole seconds. Omitted: PKINATIVE_MCP_AT when pinned, else the wall clock — pin it for reproducible bytes.

strict.description: Escalate the first engine warning to a PKI_STRICT_DIAGNOSTIC error instead of listing it in diagnostics[].

unsignedAttributes.description: Unsigned attributes, each one DER Attribute as hex (a time-stamp token already in hand: amend_cms add-timestamp checks the imprint first). A signed-only type is refused.

items.description: One DER Attribute (SEQUENCE { type, SET OF values }). Hexadecimal (an 0x prefix, colons and spaces are tolerated).

name: sign_cms

diagnostics.description: Non-fatal concerns the engine raised (PKI_DIAG_*, de-duplicated, at most 200; explain_code explains one).

diagnosticsTruncated.description: true when distinct diagnostics beyond the 200 listed were dropped.

hex.description: The artefact as lowercase hex (when encoding='hex').

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the DER bytes (lowercase hex) — the reproducibility proof.

contentBytes.description: Bytes of content signed; null when a precomputed digest was signed.

signatureVerified.description: The new signature was verified against the signer certificate before it was returned (KEY_MISMATCH otherwise).

signedAttributes.description: Signed attributes written in all (the mandatory ones included).

signingTime.description: The signingTime attribute written (ISO 8601, whole seconds), or null when omitted.

title: Sign CMS (RFC 5652 SignedData, attached or detached, Web Crypto signed)
